prompt: Estou pesquisando a relação entre democracia e comércio internacional. Preciso de dados do V-Dem para índice de democracia e do CEPII Gravity para fluxos de comércio bilateral, cobertura global, 1990-2020.
assertions: Separate download scripts exist for V-Dem and CEPII Gravity
A merge/processing script exists that combines both data sources
SOURCES.yaml contains at least 2 entries (one per data source)
DATA_DICTIONARY.md covers variables from both V-Dem and CEPII sources
README.md documents the execution order of scripts
requirements.txt lists dependencies for both data sources
